title: Always on top not working in Remote full screen
author: AntonioCarel

status.label: Duplicate or already handled
status.detail: The requested behavior crosses the local/remote desktop boundary and has an existing handled app-compat thread.

next_action.label: Close as handled by #16631
next_action.reason: Close as handled by issue 16631 and clarify that pinning must occur in the desktop session that owns the target window.

judgment.rationale: The requested behavior crosses the local/remote desktop boundary and has an existing handled app-compat thread.
evidence: The shortcut works when invoked in the remote PowerToys instance.
Issue 16631 covers the same full-screen Remote Desktop constraint.
judgment.recommended_action: Close as handled by issue 16631 and clarify that pinning must occur in the desktop session that owns the target window.

fix_assessment.rationale: A local PowerToys code fix cannot make a local HWND topmost inside a separate remote desktop session; the matching compatibility request is already handled.

issue_context.summary: Always On Top cannot pin over a full-screen Remote Desktop surface, and the hotkey may instead be received by the remote session.
known_information: The report is on PowerToys 0.68.1 and full-screen RDP.
A workaround is to disable local Always On Top and invoke the shortcut inside the remote machine.
Issue 16631 tracks the same Always On Top versus full-screen Remote Desktop behavior and is closed not planned.
inferences: A local topmost window cannot be placed inside the remote session's desktop, and full-screen RDP controls both keyboard routing and local z-order behavior.
issue_context.analysis: The live repository already handled the same app-compat scenario in issue 16631. This is not a second PowerToys implementation track unless a current report shows a local window failing outside the remote-session boundary.
initial_investigation: Issue 16631 references the broader remote-session/elevation compatibility discussion in issue 15680.

actions.label: Close as handled by #16631
actions.note: Draft only; no upstream comment is posted without explicit approval.

comment.body: Thanks for the report. Full-screen Remote Desktop owns a separate desktop/input session, so the Always On Top instance that can pin a remote window is the PowerToys instance running inside that remote session. The matching compatibility request is tracked in #16631 (with related remote-session context in #15680). Closing this as handled avoids a duplicate local implementation track; if a local window also fails to stay above RDP while both are on the local desktop, please open a current report with that distinct window arrangement.
